title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime Casts Minori Fujidera
content: The staff for the television anime of Hifumi's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) novels revealed the anime's main visual and an additional cast member on Monday.
author: ANN

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure Anime Reveals Main Visual, Additional Cast
content: The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure anime revealed a main visual and one additional cast member on Monday. Minori Fujidera joins the cast as Rina. Studio Elle is animating the series set to premiere in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 Preview Teases Magna and Zora Action
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 5 (Episode 175 overall) ahead of its October 31 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3.

title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke Game Gets New Manga Adaptation
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Saturday that SHIFT UP 's Goddess of Victory: Nikke game will receive a new official manga adaptation by Yokoshima Penguin this winter to celebrate the franchise's fourth anniversary.
author: ANN

title: New Live-Action Street Fighter Film Drops to #4 in the U.S.
content: Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series dropped from #1 to #4 in the U.S. box office in its second weekend. The film earned an estimated US$8,600,000 in the October 23-25 weekend, a 72.1% drop from its opening weekend earnings.
author: ANN

title: Rainy Day Serenade Manga Gets Spinoff Series in November
content: The December issue of Kodansha 's Kiss magazine announced on Friday that Haruka Kawachi 's Rainy Day Serenade ( Namidaame to Serenade ) manga will receive a spinoff manga series titled Namidaame to Serenade : Gaiden ( Rainy Day Serenade Side Story) in the magazine's next issue on November 25.
author: ANN

title: 24 Years Ago, This Shonen Anime Left Fans Hanging (& Its Reboot Couldn’t Save It)
content: Shaman King may not have received the anime adaptation it deserved, but it remains one of the most beloved series of all time. There’s no denying that the 1990s were a revolutionary era in the anime and manga industry, especially when it came to Shonen series.
